description: A careful writing-review workflow for protecting voice and removing generic AI patterns.

defaultPrompt: Review this draft for generic AI patterns while preserving its meaning and constraints.
Rewrite this draft in the style of these examples. Show a short review first, then the revision.
Check this final draft for visible formatting, unsupported claims, and wording that feels unlike the supplied examples.
interface.longDescription: Hold Your Voice helps you revise drafts without flattening the way you write. Share a draft and a few examples of your voice; it flags generic phrasing, protects your constraints, and improves only what needs changing.
interface.shortDescription: Make AI writing sound like you

name: hold-your-voice
